description.value: Champions Guild Automation: Cantrip: you learn Ray of Frost (add it from the compendium). Frostbite: once per turn when you hit a creature with an attack roll and deal Cold damage, the module gives it Frostbite: it subtracts 1d4 from the next saving throw it makes before the end of your next turn.

automation.notes: Champions Guild Automation: Frostbite applied by the module on the first Cold hit each turn.
